name: Balatro-TS-TW

frames.best_why: A full swirling red-and-blue marble fills the frame with clear pale-blue highlights.

tagline: Red and blue paint swirl into marbled eddies across the whole screen.
summary: A full-screen animated shader that churns deep blue and crimson into a marbled, liquid-like pattern with pale highlights, slowly rotating and drifting as it runs.
appearance: The whole area fills with a swirling, marbled pattern of deep navy blue and blood red, shot through with thin pale-blue and white streaks and glossy highlights. Dark near-black pools sit between glossy colour bands, giving the look of oil paint or polished stone in motion.
behaviour: The pattern rotates and churns continuously, its eddies drifting and re-forming as it runs. Moving the pointer nudges the swirl slightly, and colours, speed and contrast can be changed.
search_phrases: liquid paint background for a hero
oil slick pattern behind a headline
use_when: You want a bold animated backdrop that fills a hero or section and needs no images, just colour and motion.
avoid_when: It is a heavy WebGL canvas that never idles, and its dark vibrant colours may fight a light page.
customise: Three hex colours, spin rotation and speed, offset, contrast, lighting, spin amount, pixel filter, spin ease, a rotation toggle and mouse interaction are props. Nothing else changes without editing.
weight_why: A full-screen WebGL fragment shader runs a five-iteration loop on every frame.

a11y.note: A continuously running shader that ignores reduced-motion, with no way to pause it, and it needs a sized parent to fill.

issues: The shader never pauses and ignores reduced-motion, which can bother motion-sensitive users.
It needs a sized parent; as a bare canvas with h-full it collapses to zero height.
polish_why: Rich marbled motion with strong colour contrast; it is heavy and never rests.
title: Balatro Shader
